messages:
alisa: Hey @people-ops — quick Q: my first paycheck is coming this month, want to confirm how benefits deductions will appear (health/dental/401k), and whether they'll be prorated since I started mid-cycle. Also I paid for a work trip; how do I submit receipts for reimbursement? I’m on a H-1B — any special tax forms I should be aware of? Thanks!

hr_jordan: Congrats on joining, @alisa! :tada: Quick answers: 1) Payroll runs on the 1st & 15th; your first pay will be pro-rated for days worked in the period. 2) Benefits deductions: premiums typically start the first full month after your enrollment effective date (so you'll see pre-tax deductions starting the next cycle). 3) 401k contributions: if you opted in, employee deferrals start the next paycheck after your enrollment processes. 4) Reimbursements: we use Ramp + Expensify — upload receipts to Expensify, tag with project code, and route to people-ops for approval. 5) For visa/tax: payroll needs your completed W-4 and I-9 (if not already submitted) and your visa type in Workday — if anything's missing we'll withhold at default rate. DM me if you want me to check your file.

alisa: thank you!! where's the expensify link? also I haven't uploaded W-4 — I only filled onboarding doc.

hr_jordan: link: https://company-docs.internal/benefits/expense-onboarding (internal). Expensify quick start: create account with your company email, go to `New Expense` -> attach receipt -> select `People Ops > Travel` policy -> submit. For W-4: go to Workday > My Documents > Tax Forms, upload scanned W-4. If you prefer, I can email you a PDF to sign.

ben_dev: FYI — if you paid for flight, make sure you include itinerary + corporate card statement (if you don't have one) so we can match.

mike_manager: @alisa :wave: ping me if you need help expensing — I can approve faster. Also welcome to the team!

sara: I'll help tag the expense once it's in Expensify, include the project code RD-ENG-42.

payroll_bot: Payroll reminder: Upcoming run 1769905600 scheduled. If tax docs are incomplete, default withholding applies.

hr_jordan: Also holiday schedule & PTO accrual is here: https://company-docs.internal/hr/holidays-and-pto. PTO accrues monthly at 1.25 days/mo for accrual plan A; prorated for new hires. Public holidays listed for US & EU. Let me know country if you need specifics.

alisa: I'm US-based, thanks! One more — dental starts when? I selected it on Day 2.

hr_jordan: Dental effective date: first day of next month after enrollment processed — so expect deduction and coverage to start then. If you'd like proof of coverage earlier, we can generate a 'pending coverage' letter.

alisa: perfect, appreciate it :heart: 

hr_jordan: Closing thread — feel free to DM if anything else. :thumbsup:
